_comment: LOCAL VERIFICATION BASEMAP — NOT FOR PRODUCTION.
The production map uses mapbox://styles/mapbox/dark-v11, which needs a
Mapbox access token. This style exists so the construction-marker system
can be reviewed against a real dark basemap with real roads and locality
structure on a machine that has no token, by pointing
Nothing in the application references this file. Deleting it changes no
behaviour. Tiles are CARTO's free dark_matter raster basemap; the
attribution below is required by their terms and is rendered by Mapbox GL.
name: Dreame local verification (dark)
